definitions: A muscle in the chest, especially one of the two large muscles (pectoralis major and pectoralis minor) that connect the front of the chest with the bones of the upper arm and shoulder.
A breastplate or an ornamental plate worn on the chest, especially by a priest or high priest.
A medicine for diseases of the chest or lungs.
examples: He worked on his pectorals at the gym.
The high priest wore a magnificent pectoral.
She took a pectoral for her cough.
